title: Operator asks about Limo Anywhere before trip
persona: Dale Hutchins, runs a six-car limo company in Tulsa. Slow, drawling, direct.
goal: Find out if AI Chauffeur works with Limo Anywhere, then place a demo airport trip.
opening_line: Yeah hi, I run a limo outfit and I use Limo Anywhere. Does this thing work with that?

turns.caller: Okay so how does it get the trips in there, like automatically?

branches.if_agent: Says it cannot confirm integration details and offers the team
branches.caller: Fine, the team can tell me. But let me try a trip real quick.

turns.caller: Alright, I need a pickup at Tulsa International Airport. I'm landing Friday.
Flight is American 1432. Gets in around 4:15 in the afternoon.
Two passengers. And three bags, maybe four.
Taking us to the Hyatt Regency downtown.
Sedan is fine. Name's Dale Hutchins.
Does it also work with the drivers' app part, or just the booking?

curveballs: Asks about a named dispatch product mid-intake
Gives bag count as a range
Returns to software question after intake
hesitation_rules: Says 'uh, hang on' before giving the flight number and again before the cell number.
expected: Does not claim confirmed integration with Limo Anywhere unless the product info supports it
Offers to move to questions or the team for software details
Names Tulsa International Airport in full, never a code
Continues capturing the trip details without re-asking given ones
Says the request goes to dispatch or the team
must_not: Quote a fare or rate for the trip
Refer to an owner or a named person
